eyebrow: Replaces the action — it doesn't follow it
code:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_SomeView_InsteadOfInsert
ON dbo.SomeView
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
BEGIN
    -- The real INSERT goes here.
    -- Skip it, and nothing is written anywhere.
END;
caption: AFTER runs once the change happened. INSTEAD OF runs in its place.

code:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_EmployeeDirectory_InsteadOfUpdate
ON dbo.EmployeeDirectory
INSTEAD OF UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    UPDATE p SET p.FirstName = i.FirstName,
                 p.LastName = i.LastName
    FROM Person.Person AS p
    JOIN inserted AS i ON i.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID;

    UPDATE e SET e.JobTitle = i.JobTitle
    FROM HumanResources.Employee AS e
    JOIN inserted AS i ON i.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID;
END;
caption: The trigger routes each column to the correct real table.
